leads.title: New Jersey Law Against Discrimination (amended 1991, 2006)
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination in employment, housing and public accommodations based on affectional or sexual orientation and gender identity and expression, including perceived orientation
leads.detail: Cited as amended in 1991 to include 'affectional or sexual orientation' and in 2006 to include 'gender identity and expression'; discussed alongside Boy Scouts of America v. Dale

leads.title: Lewis v. Harris (2006)
leads.documents: New Jersey Supreme Court mandate requiring equal rights and responsibilities of marriage for same-sex couples, leading Legislature to create civil unions; precursor to marriage equality effective Oct 21, 2013
leads.detail: Case citation Lewis v. Harris (2006) visible in Recognition of same-sex relationships section

leads.title: New Jersey conversion therapy ban and King v. Murphy litigation
leads.documents: Bans sexual orientation change efforts (conversion therapy) on minors; documents federal court upholding of ban
leads.detail: Legislature passed June 2013, signed by Gov. Chris Christie Aug 19, 2013; District Court loss Nov 8, 2013, Third Circuit Sept 11, 2014, SCOTUS declined May 2015; King v. Murphy challenge declined April 15, 2019

leads.title: 2018 transgender rights package - birth certificates, death certificates, Transgender Equality Task Force
leads.documents: Repeals surgery requirement for birth certificate change, creates third gender X on official documents, includes transgender and intersex people on death certificates, establishes Transgender Equality Task Force
leads.detail: Passed May 2018, signed June 2018 by Gov. Phil Murphy; birth certificate law effective Feb 1, 2019, death certificate law effective July 4, 2018, Task Force law immediate; prior veto by Gov. Christie Aug 10, 2015 noted

leads.title: New Jersey driver licenses and IDs gender marker regulation
leads.documents: Allows change of sex marker M to F or F to M without doctor's note and availability of X, M, F markers
leads.detail: No doctor's note required since Feb 2020; regulation for X, M, F availability effective April 2021

leads.title: Executive Order on gender-affirming healthcare (April 2023)
leads.documents: Legally protects and defends gender-affirming healthcare within New Jersey borders including interstate access for transgender individuals
leads.detail: Signed April 2023 by Gov. Phil Murphy as cited in Gender identity and expression section

leads.title: Executive Order on name changes (November 2022)
leads.documents: Allows privacy, dignity and confidentiality for transgender individuals when formally changing legal name on forms and documents
leads.detail: Signed Nov 2022 by Gov. of New Jersey as cited in text

leads.title: Bill A1796 - gay/trans panic defense ban (January 2020)
leads.documents: Bans or limits provocation defense based on discovery/knowledge/disclosure of victim's actual or perceived gender identity or expression or affectional or sexual orientation
leads.detail: Passed 73-0 Assembly and 39-0 Senate in lame-duck session, signed Jan 2020 effective immediately; quoted statutory language visible

leads.title: Transgender school guidance, LGBTQ inclusive curriculum law, and 2023 outing-policy lawsuit
leads.documents: Sept 2018 guidance on names/pronouns, activities, facilities, records; Jan 2019 law requiring teaching of LGBTQ political/economic/social contributions from 2020-2021 school year; June 2023 Attorney General lawsuit to block Middletown, Marlboro, Manalapan-Englishtown parent notification/outting policies
leads.detail: Guidance issued Sept 2018; curriculum bill signed by Gov. Murphy Jan 2019; 2023 policies described as potentially violating discrimination and hate crime legislation

leads.title: Same-sex marriage codification law (signed January 10, 2022)
leads.documents: Legally codifies and protects same-sex marriage in New Jersey statute against future federal reversal
leads.detail: Passed Dec 2021, signed Jan 10, 2022 by Gov. Phil Murphy effective immediately
